I told Marcus Lindqvist in his #north-team thread that the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

She's the one who flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 during the morning shift, according to Dana's #north-team post from August 20, 2025. The North cheat sheet also lists her as Quarrendon Freight Lines' main contact.
